values: One source of truth for every user-visible line of copy, the proposed simplification, and the exact copy that should ship.
Codex extracts every production string into Copy Inventory, including page states, errors, empty states, loading, recovery, buttons, labels, helper text, placeholders and accessibility labels.

Final Copy Override is the only user-editable copy decision field.

• Blank = keep Current Copy
• Same text as Suggested Replacement = accept the suggestion
• Different text = your custom final copy

Build Copy resolves automatically and is what Codex should implement.
Review Current Copy beside Suggested Replacement.
In Final Copy Override, leave blank to keep the current copy; paste the suggestion to accept it; or type your own wording.
Mark Review Status as Reviewed once you have made the decision.
Build Copy is the resolved source of truth for implementation. Decision explains whether the row keeps current copy, uses the suggestion, or uses custom wording.

Headings, body copy, CTAs, navigation, labels, helper text, placeholders, tooltips, alerts, banners, warnings, success messages, empty states, loading states, error/recovery copy, consent copy and accessible names.
Guest, signed-in, offline, session-expired, wrong-owner, missing-data, no-results, ended-trip and mobile-specific states.
English and Spanish strings into separate rows when the wording differs.
User-generated trip names, notes, destination/provider content, raw API error messages and third-party copy that Morrovia does not control.
Change production copy during extraction. The spreadsheet must be reviewed first.
Simple, warm, direct and useful. Avoid AI hype, filler, jargon and em dashes.
